newsitem.title: CHINA: China bicycle makers win U.S. anti-dumping case.
newsitem.headline: China bicycle makers win U.S. anti-dumping case.

text.p: More than 20 Chinese bicycle makers have been cleared of charges of dumping their goods on the U.S. market, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Three U.S. companies launched an anti-dumping investigation against the Chinese companies in April 1995, accusing them of dumping bicycles worth $200 million on the U.S. market, Xinhua said.
"The U.S. International Trade Commission decided...that China-made bicycles exported to the U.S. were not an economic threat to related industries in the United States," Xinhua said.
The United States and Europe have accused China of dumping light industrial goods, such as shoes and textiles, on their markets.
